reviews.title: All over the place
reviews.text: If you have ADHD or, OCD this is not the app for you. The concept is good but unfortunately after you enter all your morning, noon, evening tasks to do. When you go into your list to check off the task it’s not in the order you entered them. I even tried setting a time for each task and the task will be set wherever. You have to go hunting for your task. The task will not be in the order you want them no matter how you set them up. Even tried the morning, afternoon, evening tabs and go into each tab separately. Nope all my task are all over the place. So if I have a task to complete in the morning, another in the evening, three in the afternoon. The tasks will be all over the place and you have to go searching each one individually if you remember which one they were. The app will give you anxiety and make your ADHD worse. I reached out the developer and received an email it’s a glitch and they are working on it. I asked for a refund and they went silent. Never responded to my email after that. Refund policy is a lie. I had to let the app sit on my phone for almost a year because I paid for a year subscription with no use. I will go in the app from time and time to see if they fixed the glitch and they haven’t. I think people on here leaving positive feedback either are paid to do so, or their lives must be just as disarrayed as the app is and they don’t mind. But for someone who has ADHD, OCD, or like organization in their lives this is not the app for you.

reviews.text: Je pensais utiliser l’essaie gratuit de 7 jours mais le prélèvement est immédiat. Ils m’ont bien eu.
